name: 10 Minute School Ghore Boshe Spoken English Course
description: Self-paced online English speaking course instructed by Munzereen Shahid featuring 70 situational video lectures, 9 chapter quizzes, practice notes, and 57 vocabulary flashcards. Helps students and job seekers overcome speaking anxiety and master fluency for interviews, office presentations, and daily conversations without complex grammar rules. Includes lifetime access and a shareable completion certificate.
